# Stance

> > Stance is a lifestyle brand offering premium socks, underwear, and apparel designed with comfort, creativity, and social impact in mind.

Stance specializes in high-quality socks across multiple styles, cushioning levels, and performance categories, alongside collaborations with artists and brands. The site features curated collections, new arrivals, and sales, catering to both casual wearers and athletes.

## Key Topics

- Icon Socks
- Performance Socks
- Crew Socks
- Compression Socks
- Butter Blend
- Athletic Socks
- Quarter Socks
- No-Show Socks
- Cushioning Technology
- Artist Collaborations
- Sock Collections
- Apparel
- Gift Sets
- Casual Socks

## Shop by Collection

- [Homepage](https://www.stance.com): Stance homepage showcasing socks, underwear, apparel and artist collaborations
- [All Socks](https://www.stance.com/collections/socks): Complete socks collection catalog with filter and sort functionality
- [New Arrivals](https://www.stance.com/collections/new-arrivals-socks): New arrivals collection showcasing latest sock and apparel designs
- [Best Sellers](https://www.stance.com/collections/socks-best-sellers): Best-selling socks collection featuring popular comfort and creative styles
- [Sale](https://www.stance.com/collections/sale): Sale collection featuring discounted socks, underwear and apparel bundles
- [Collaborations](https://www.stance.com/collections/collaborations): Limited edition collaborations with artists, brands including Disney and Arizona Iced Tea
- [Packs & Box Sets](https://www.stance.com/collections/box-sets-packs): Curated sock packs and box sets bundling Icons, performance and gift sets

## Shop by Style

- [Icon Socks](https://www.stance.com/collections/icon-socks): Icon collection signature everyday essentials with classic designs and cushioning
- [Crew Socks](https://www.stance.com/collections/crew-socks): Crew socks collection blending design and technology for casual and performance
- [Quarter Socks](https://www.stance.com/collections/quarter-socks): Quarter socks landing above ankle, mid-point between no-show and crew
- [No-Show Socks](https://www.stance.com/collections/no-show-socks): No-show socks with deep heel pockets and no-slip grip technology
- [Tab Socks](https://www.stance.com/collections/tab-socks): Tab socks hitting below ankle with namesake tag to prevent rubbing
- [Over the Calf Socks](https://www.stance.com/collections/over-the-calf-socks): Over-the-calf socks with full coverage for snow sports and all-day comfort
- [Butter Blend Socks](https://www.stance.com/collections/butterblend-socks): Butter Blend™ collection featuring soft socks in crew and quarter styles

## Performance & Specialty

- [Performance Socks](https://www.stance.com/collections/performance-socks): Performance socks collection for athletes with design and technology
- [Athletic Socks](https://www.stance.com/collections/athletic-socks): Athletic socks engineered with cushioning and support for training
- [Compression Socks](https://www.stance.com/collections/compression): Compression socks with graduated technology for recovery and performance

## Shop by Cushioning

- [Ultralight Cushion](https://www.stance.com/collections/ultralight-cushion-socks): Ultralight cushion socks with minimal padding for breathability
- [Light Cushion](https://www.stance.com/collections/light-cushion-socks): Light cushion socks offering targeted support for everyday and medium-impact wear
- [Medium Cushion](https://www.stance.com/collections/medium-cushion-socks): Medium cushion socks with balanced comfort for all-day wear and activities
